patthana17.25:1.1: savitakkasavicāraṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na savitakkasavicāro na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana17.25:2.1: avitakkavicāramattaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na avitakkavicāramatto na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā paṇṇarasa.
patthana17.25:3.1: savitakkasavicāraṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na savitakkasavicāro na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā nava.
